newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end up on pre-holiday short-covering.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end up on pre-holiday short-covering.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures reversed their downward trend to settle near the day's highs.
Dealers attributed gains to technically-driven local and speculative short-covering ahead of a two-day holiday beginning Thursday, rather than to any bullish news.
"When we come back it will be December. It makes sense not to be short in the month of December," an analyst said in reference to colder temperatures.
She added that the technical indicators have also been creeping towards oversold. Finally, the market failed to break Monday's low in early trade.
January closed 2.10 cent a lb higher at 97.00, having ranged from 97.40 to 95.00. The deferred months finished 1.80 to 1.55 higher.
